result_text: Closing without building the described client. This task's premise (ESP32-S3 → MQTT → gateway FastAPI/PostgreSQL) does not match SPARK's actual locked architecture at any point in tracker history checked (v54, github.com/AaradhyaDT/SPARK @ 53f194d): transport is BLE (gateway/receiver/receiver.py's BleReceiver, via bleak — not MQTT), storage is a local JSON store (gateway/storage/json_store.py — not PostgreSQL), and the gateway API is a standalone lightweight HTTP server (gateway/server.py: GET /, /api/health, /api/events, /api/events/<id>, /api/reports/<id> — not FastAPI). Layer 3 (§2.1, locked v35) is a read-only display client that pulls a completed report from the laptop gateway over local network after Layer 2 finishes — no direct BLE link, no on-device SHAP/PDF, and per v35's own rationale, deliberately NOT a full-pipeline reimplementation to avoid duplicating pipeline logic across laptop and phone. Sonia Thapa is the assigned WBS owner for the mobile/web display client (§3), consuming gateway/server.py's existing REST endpoints. If a phone client is still wanted, it should be re-scoped as: "build a display-only client (web or native) against gateway/server.py's existing REST API — GET /api/events + /api/events/<id> — no MQTT, no FastAPI, no PostgreSQL, no direct wearable connection." Not creating that as a new task on this task's authority — leaving that decision to Aaradhya/Sonia.
summary: Closed — spec's architecture premise doesn't match locked design, not executed as written.
